name: knowledge-base
title: Knowledge base — files, text and URLs
description: The knowledge base as a resource the agent queries rather than prompt text: documents added from files, a pasted note or a URL, each carrying its extraction state, and the summary that tells the agent when to reach for it.

export type SourceKind = "pdf" | "docx" | "txt" | "markdown" | "url" | "text"

export const SOURCE_LABELS: Record<SourceKind, string> = {
  pdf: "PDF",
  docx: "DOCX",
  txt: "TXT",
  markdown: "Markdown",
  url: "URL",
  text: "Text",
}

export type SourceStatus = "ready" | "extracting" | "failed"

export type Source = {
  id: string
  name: string
  kind: SourceKind
  url?: string
  status: SourceStatus
  size: string
  addedBy: string
  addedAt: string
  problem?: string
  body?: string
}

export function isFileSource(kind: SourceKind): boolean {
  return kind !== "url" && kind !== "text"
}

/** Rows store the address without a scheme; a link still needs one. */
export function sourceHref(url: string): string {
  return /^https?:\/\//i.test(url) ? url : `https://${url}`
}

export function sentenceCount(summary: string): number {
  return summary.split(/[.!?]+\s|[.!?]+$/).filter((part) => part.trim()).length
}

export const SUMMARY_SENTENCE_LIMIT = 10

export function pendingSource(id: string, name: string, size: string): Source {
  const extension = name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? ""
  const kind: SourceKind =
    extension === "docx"
      ? "docx"
      : extension === "txt"
        ? "txt"
        : extension === "md"
          ? "markdown"
          : "pdf"

  return {
    id,
    name,
    kind,
    status: "extracting",
    size,
    addedBy: "talzamel@sarj.ai",
    addedAt: "Just now",
  }
}
